title: fix(polli-cli): stop /exit in gen chat from being sent as a message
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fix: `/exit` fell through the line handler, so "/exit" was sent to the API (billed) and the closed readline was prompted again (`ERR_USE_AFTER_CLOSE`)
- Fix: no prompt after readline closed from a fatal API error or EOF mid-turn; the close handler no longer overwrites exit code 1 with 0
- Transcript is saved once, by the close handler, so it no longer includes `/exit`
- Smaller version of #15794 by @rekty (co-author); keeps their 5 tests, which all fail on `main` and pass here

Fixes #15792

gist.headline: An exit is not a message
gist.blurb: Polli CLI learns to take `/exit` literally. It closes the chat without sending a message to the API or asking one more question on the way out.
gist.summary: Polli CLI's `gen chat` handles `/exit`, EOF, and fatal API errors without prompting a closed readline; the close handler saves the transcript once and preserves error exit code 1.
gist.impact: Leaving with `/exit` makes no API request and leaves no `/exit` in the transcript, while chats ending on an API error keep their nonzero exit status.
